title: src/**/*.py misses files directly under src/
statement:
Our build selects its inputs with buildkit.globmatch patterns, and top-level files keep dropping out:

    >>> from buildkit.globmatch import match, select
    >>> match('src/**/*.py', 'src/main.py')
    False        # expected True
    >>> match('src/**/*.py', 'src/pkg/util.py')
    True
    >>> match('**/test_*.py', 'test_cli.py')
    False        # expected True
    >>> select(['src/main.py', 'src/pkg/util.py'], ['src/**/*.py'])
    ['src/pkg/util.py']

The module docstring defines the pattern syntax, including what ** may match. Please fix matching so it follows the docstring for every pattern; the other wildcards must keep working as documented.
